message:
The yen receipt now prints `Paid ¥500 by card`, and all 18 tests pass.

The cause is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so it treats yen as if it had cents. That file is outside `src/payments`, so I left it alone. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, which now formats JPY as whole units and passes every other currency to `formatMoney` as before.

Invoices, cart and admin also use `formatMoney`, so they will still show yen wrong (`¥5.00`). The proper fix is in `money.js`, which the owning team would need to make.
